Hydraulic_Jumping_Legs.description: Equipped with hydraulic joints, these arachnid legs pulse with a sinister fluid, granting their bearer an unparalleled agility and the ability to leap incredible distances, turning even the densest underbrush into a navigable obstacle course.

Stilt_Walking_Elongation.description: Equipped with arachnid stilts, this component grants the user an uncanny elongation of their legs, enhancing their reach and stealth, though it comes at the cost of some strength, allowing for swift and nimble movements through dense underbrush and over obstacles with ease.

Laterigrade_Crab_Legs.description: Equipped with laterigrade crab legs, these arachnid-like limbs allow for swift, sideways movement through tight spaces and over rugged terrain, enhancing agility and evasion while granting the ability to ambush prey with eerie precision.

Tarsal_Clawed_Hooks.description: Equipped with razor-sharp, articulated claws that allow for both stealthy and powerful movements, these tarsal hooks are the arachnid's secret to scaling sheer surfaces and ensnaring prey with deadly precision, enhancing the wielder's agility and strength.

Heavy_Tarantula_Pillars.description: The Heavy Tarantula Pillars are thick, robust limbs that resemble the legs of a colossal arachnid, enhancing one's strength and endurance but at the cost of agility, allowing them to traverse rugged terrains with ease and resist being knocked off balance.

Water_Striding_Tarsi.description: The Water Striding Tarsi are elongated, delicate legs that allow their arachnid bearers to walk effortlessly atop water's surface, their natural stealth enhanced by the ability to glide silently through both land and liquid, making them formidable hunters in any environment.

Cryptic_Stick_Mimicry_Legs.description: Equipped with the eerie grace of an arachnid, these legs seamlessly blend into the shadows, granting the user unparalleled stealth as they skitter across the ground, though at the cost of some agility.

Burrowing_Scorpion_Legs.description: Equipped with thick, heavily armored legs that grant immense strength and resilience, these burrowing scorpion legs allow their bearer to dig swiftly into the earth and emerge from unexpected angles, striking with the force of a steel-clad warrior.

Web_Vibrational_Receptors.description: The arachnid's legs are adorned with delicate, vibrational receptors that allow it to perceive the slightest tremors and vibrations in the air and webbing, enhancing its perception and initiative in the shadows.

Spiny_Calcar_Defensive_Legs.description: Equipped with thick, spiny calcar extensions that bristle with sharp spines, these arachnid legs not only provide a formidable defensive shield but also grant the creature an enhanced natural armor and improved strength, making them a fearsome deterrent and an invaluable defensive asset.
